summary: Module 08 VERIFY: Answered verification questions on search design. Building SQL with string concatenation leads to SQL injection. Capping page_size protects database/application memory against malicious or accidental heavy queries (DoS prevention). Search engines introduce additional operational costs: managing new infrastructure nodes, data synchronization lag/sync jobs, and code complexity.
evidence: String concatenation allows input to break out of query boundaries and execute arbitrary SQL commands (SQL Injection).
Uncapped page_size can cause high memory usage, high database load, and application crashes (DoS).
Dedicated search engines add complex sync pipelines, synchronization lag, and infrastructure maintenance overhead.
